description: Phase-49 RESEARCH-ONLY semantic bound guard for missing_bound / missing_floor / missing_ceil / missing_scale candidates. Read ONLY by scripts/bound_semantics_gate.py (un-wired). Runs AFTER the P45 advancement gate and the P47 dataflow gate. It can ONLY demote (ADVANCE->REVIEW_ONLY/ABSTAIN, REVIEW_ONLY->ABSTAIN) and never promotes. A candidate may stay ADVANCE only if the alleged bound term is semantically used as a value-domain constraint, not merely present as overloaded math/rounding vocabulary. Two demotion rules: (1) a rounding-overloaded term (floor/ceil/ceiling) whose only occurrences across target+siblings are rounding/math-helper vocabulary; (2) a view/pure target that neither enforces a numeric bound itself nor has its return proven to feed a mutating value/authority path. Generic only — NO subject identifiers. is_gate:false research_only:true routes_in_production:false routed_manifest_ids:[].
